selection_rationale: Pure clearance ranking puts CAND_0_THIN first (7.50 mm vs 6.22 mm overall). CAND_0_THIN however has 0 deg hard-limit margin: all six joints rest on their hard stops, which is not an acceptable launch-locked configuration. CAND_2_FIT keeps 2 deg of hard-limit margin, still passes rail keep-out and virtual ejection, and retains 5.22 mm overall clearance at delta = 1.0 mm. CAND_0_THIN is retained as the clearance-optimal reference only.
